messages:
mia: Heads-up — planning to onboard nebula-4.7b into the model-catalog and pin it as the default v1.0 for short-text generation workloads. Target deploy: Wed 2026-03-18 22:00 UTC (maintenance window). Who can own the deploy + smoke checks? PR is #8423 (needs one more review). Also confirm quantized variant exists and rollback is tested.

sam: I can own the deploy portion. Will be doing infra prep earlier in the day, then hand off smoke to someone on the ML side. Quick note: left one tiny nit on the PR but LGTM otherwise.

jordan: Canary plan suggested: start at 5% traffic for 30m, then 25% for 1h if metrics look good, then full roll. Config snippet: `canary: [{pct:5, duration:1800}, {pct:25, duration:3600}]`.

lee: I can run smoke checks and do the verification checklist. What are the exact smoke metrics we want to gate on? p95 latency, tok/s, and some sample-quality checks? Also need the eval prompt set link.

mia: yes — gate on p95 (<260ms on dedup route), tok/s within 10% of baseline, error rate <0.1%. Eval set: https://internal.redwood/models/nebula/evals/short-gen-2026-03-10. Runbook + rollback steps here: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/model-onboard.md#nebula-4.7b. Pin name will be `nebula-4.7b@2026-03-17`.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created by @sam for 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z. Canary config attached. Deployment id: dpl-20260318-67. Watch channel: #eng-ml and #eng-oncall.

ops-oncall: I'll be on-standby during the window. Rollback command: `rictl deploy rollback --deployment dpl-20260318-67` (this reverts routing + pin). If rollback needed, call me and post the reason in the thread.

sam: infra prep checklist: ensure nodepool has >= 12x A100 spare, autoscaler min bumped for the window, and the model cache warming job scheduled 15m prior. Pre-warm curl (example): `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"warm"}' https://api.redwood/models/nebula-4.7b/generate`

jordan: PR merged (commit abcdef123). CI green. Quantized variant `nebula-4.7b-q8` present in registry and validated on staging.

lee: I'll run the smoke script: `scripts/smoke_nebula.sh --canary dpl-20260318-67` and post the smoke summary here. Plan to run quick hallucination checks from eval set and paste 10 samples.

mia: Perfect. After canary hits 25% for 1h and metrics are stable, I'll flip the model pin to `nebula-4.7b@2026-03-17` and announce in #general. If anything odd shows up (latency or quality regression), we'll rollback and open an incident.

sam: small note — update routing policy to prefer nebula for prompts <256 tokens only (so longform routes still go to titan-13b). I'll push the routing change right before the pin flip.

lee: smoke results (pre-canary run): p50 62ms, p95 198ms, error 0.02%. Sample checks look good. Will run again during canary and report.

ops-oncall: confirmed I'll be reachable via phone. If we need immediate rollback: I'm ok to execute.

mia: thanks everyone — tagging final checklist: (1) infra prep done (sam) (2) CR merged (jordan) (3) smoke owner (lee) (4) oncall standby (ops-oncall) (5) runbook + rollback verified (all). See you in the window. :thumbsup:

sam: leaving post-deploy note to update the cost dashboard for nebula q8 numbers tomorrow.

jordan: adding a small monitoring alert to watch transform latency spikes >20% relative to baseline for 15m.

mia: awesome — will close the thread after post-deploy verification (target +60m after full flip).
